project_type: Python quantitative finance library with 100 strategies, 100 algorithms, backtesting engine, and portfolio construction
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures (sample_ohlcv, sample_prices, sample_returns, sample_signals)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pip install -e '.[dev]' to install. 2. Run pytest tests/ -v --tb=short. All tests must pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 default. numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, cvxpy available.
contribution_requirements: Type hints required. NumPy-style docstrings. from __future__ import annotations. Strategy extends Strategy base, Algorithm extends Algorithm base. Tests on synthetic data.
key_patterns: Modular subpackages under src/quant_portfolio/. Each module has __init__.py with exports. BacktestResult dataclass has: returns (pd.Series), equity_curve (pd.Series), positions (pd.DataFrame with 'position' column), trades (pd.DataFrame), metrics (Dict[str,float]). Existing metrics.py has standalone functions. Tests use pytest fixtures from conftest.py. Registry pattern via __init_subclass__.
directory_structure: src/quant_portfolio/ - main package; strategies/ - 100 strategies in 8 categories; algorithms/ - 100 algorithms in 7 categories; backtesting/ - engine.py + metrics.py; portfolio/ - constructor.py + risk.py; data/ - baostock_provider.py + data_utils.py; tests/ - pytest test files; examples/ - usage scripts; docs/ - markdown docs
